purpose: Represent natural weapons, natural armor and mechanically relevant organs as body-structure-bound references to shared mechanics and, when appropriate, ItemDefinition/Equipment profiles without converting intrinsic anatomy into owned inventory by default.
source_basis: MVPS-03 morphology/body-plan contract reserves natural weapon/armor mechanics to MVPS-06
ITEM_FAMILY_DISCOVERY.md object/non-object boundary: intrinsic properties remain on host; independently acquired/installed/removed/transferred/tracked modifications are items
PPIA-03 Item/Inventory workflow distinction between Item Definition, Asset Instance, ownership and equipment assignment
PPIA-05 Ability/Biology routing: biological-looking names do not establish exact mechanics

natural_equipment_declaration.rule: body_structure_ref binds the capability to morphology. mechanic_refs point to shared owner records. Optional ItemDefinition/Equipment references reuse standardized weapon/armor/equipment profiles but do not by themselves create an Asset Instance or ownership relation.

item_domain_routing.intrinsic_anatomy: Remain a body structure plus shared mechanic references. Damage/loss/state routes through owning body/Condition/Effect systems rather than generic inventory ownership.
item_domain_routing.reusable_item_profile: An ItemDefinition/Equipment profile may be referenced when it is the canonical owner of weapon/armor/equipment behavior; this reference is descriptive of mechanics ownership, not proof of a carried Asset.
item_domain_routing.independently_tracked_object: If a biological/cybernetic structure is independently acquired, installed, removed, transferred, possessed, sold, repaired as an Asset, or otherwise inventory-tracked, hand off to the Item/Equipment workflow and preserve the host/body relation separately.
item_domain_routing.ambiguity: If source authority cannot determine intrinsic structure versus independent Item/Asset semantics, retain an unresolved routing state rather than guessing.

compatibility_boundary.rule: MVPS-06 exposes body_structure_ref and shared mechanic/item/equipment references. Clothing/armor/tool/vehicle/mount/interface fit decisions are not authored here.

form_boundary.rule: MVPS-06 does not define how natural equipment appears, disappears, is retained, or is replaced during transformation.

progression_boundary.rule: MVPS-06 does not define maturation or progression unlock timing for natural equipment.
